ratings.notes: Accurately frames metformin as protective; good mechanistic detail and limitations. PMID citations plausible but unverified. Concentration mismatch point well-made.
Reverses dominant evidence direction—claims metformin increases cancer risk. Fabricated/unsupported citations (CAROLINA, EXSCEL cancer data, pooled RR>1). Misleading framing.
Accurate inverse-association framing, solid limitations section, includes testable hypothesis. Slightly less mechanistic depth than PP005-A but well-structured and grounded.
Correct direction, reasonable citations, good limitations. 'Graph-confirmed path' notation adds no scientific value and slightly reduces clarity. Otherwise solid.

result.pairwise_reason: PP005-A provides the most complete, mechanistically detailed, and accurately grounded response covering human epidemiology, animal models, and in-vitro evidence with well-articulated limitations. PP005-B is disqualified by fabricated citations and incorrect directionality.
